entries.title: Matthew 10:1
segments: ¶And when He had called His twelve disciples to [Him], He gave them power [over] unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal all kinds of sickness and all kinds of disease.

entries.title: Matthew 10:2
segments: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these: first, Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew his brother; James the [son] of Zebedee, and John his brother;

entries.title: Matthew 10:3
segments: Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew the tax collector; James the [son] of Alphaeus, and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

entries.title: Matthew 10:4
segments: Simon the Canaanite, and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed Him.

entries.title: Matthew 10:5
segments: ¶These twelve Jesus sent out and commanded them, saying: "Do not go into the way of the Gentiles, and do not enter a city of the Samaritans.

entries.title: Matthew 10:6
segments: "But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

entries.title: Matthew 10:7
segments: "And as you go, preach, saying, 'The kingdom of heaven is at hand.'

entries.title: Matthew 10:8
segments: "Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, raise the dead, cast out demons. Freely you have received, freely give.

entries.title: Matthew 10:9
segments: "Provide neither gold nor silver nor copper in your money belts,

entries.title: Matthew 10:10
segments: "nor bag for [your] journey, nor two tunics, nor sandals, nor staffs; for a worker is worthy of his food.

entries.title: Matthew 10:11
segments: "Now whatever city or town you enter, inquire who in it is worthy, and stay there till you go out.

entries.title: Matthew 10:12
segments: "And when you go into a household, greet it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:13
segments: "If the household is worthy, let your peace come upon it. But if it is not worthy, let your peace return to you.

entries.title: Matthew 10:14
segments: "And whoever will not receive you nor hear your words, when you depart from that house or city, shake off the dust from your feet.

entries.title: Matthew 10:15
segments: "Assuredly, I say to you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!

entries.title: Matthew 10:16
segments: ¶"Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

entries.title: Matthew 10:17
segments: "But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils and scourge you in their synagogues.

entries.title: Matthew 10:18
segments: "You will be brought before governors and kings for My sake, as a testimony to them and to the Gentiles.

entries.title: Matthew 10:19
segments: "But when they deliver you up, do not worry about how or what you should speak. For it will be given to you in that hour what you should speak;

entries.title: Matthew 10:20
segments: "for it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

entries.title: Matthew 10:21
segments: "Now brother will deliver up brother to death, and a father [his] child; and children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

entries.title: Matthew 10:22
segments: "And you will be hated by all for My name's sake. But he who endures to the end will be saved.

entries.title: Matthew 10:23
segments: "When they persecute you in this city, flee to another. For assuredly, I say to you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel before the Son of Man comes.

entries.title: Matthew 10:24
segments: "A disciple is not above [his] teacher, nor a servant above his master.

entries.title: Matthew 10:25
segments: "It is enough for a disciple that he be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more [will they call] those of his household!

entries.title: Matthew 10:26
segments: "Therefore do not fear them. For there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, and hidden that will not be known.

entries.title: Matthew 10:27
segments: "Whatever I tell you in the dark, speak in the light; and what you hear in the ear, preach on the housetops.

entries.title: Matthew 10:28
segments: "And do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. But rather fear Him who is able to destroy both soul and body in hell.

entries.title: Matthew 10:29
segments: "Are not two sparrows sold for a copper coin? And not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father's will.

entries.title: Matthew 10:30
segments: "But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

entries.title: Matthew 10:31
segments: "Do not fear therefore; you are of more value than many sparrows.

entries.title: Matthew 10:32
segments: "Therefore whoever confesses Me before men, him I will also confess before My Father who is in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 10:33
segments: "But whoever denies Me before men, him I will also deny before My Father who is in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 10:34
segments: "Do not think that I came to bring peace on earth. I did not come to bring peace but a sword.

entries.title: Matthew 10:35
segments: "For I have come to 'set a man against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law';

entries.title: Matthew 10:36
segments: "and 'a man's enemies will be those of his [own] household.'

entries.title: Matthew 10:37
segments: "He who loves father or mother more than Me is not worthy of Me. And he who loves son or daughter more than Me is not worthy of Me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:38
segments: "And he who does not take his cross and follow after Me is not worthy of Me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:39
segments: "He who finds his life will lose it, and he who loses his life for My sake will find it.

entries.title: Matthew 10:40
segments: "He who receives you receives Me, and he who receives Me receives Him who sent Me.

entries.title: Matthew 10:41
segments: "He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward. And he who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man shall receive a righteous man's reward.

entries.title: Matthew 10:42
segments: "And whoever gives one of these little ones only a cup of cold [water] in the name of a disciple, assuredly, I say to you, he shall by no means lose his reward."
